findings.title: Operasi berdasarkan ID kedua belum tercakup
findings.problem: Controller memeriksa keberadaan ID yang diminta tetapi selalu mengambil record pertama. Semua test sukses memakai record pertama sehingga pelanggaran pada ID kedua tidak terlihat.
findings.proof: wrong_first passes every original internal/reference suite for all five resources; five independent categories tests reject it in four cases.
findings.contract: PRD9.1 show/update/destroy must address requested target and preserve other records.
findings.required_action: Add successful show/update/destroy requests for a non-first existing ID, checking returned ID/body and both target/neighbour database rows, in independent internal/reference suites.

findings.title: String pendek yang sah belum diuji positif
findings.problem: Tujuh field string required tanpa min tidak memiliki uji positif panjang1atau2. Controller yang menambahkan min:3 tidak sah masih lulus semua kasus.
findings.proof: overstrict_min3 passes every original internal/reference suite for all five resources; independent categories short POST/PUT tests correctly fail with422.
findings.contract: Declared required/string/max rules permit nonempty short strings when no min is declared.
findings.required_action: Add valid minimum nonempty strings and short examples on POST/PUT; preserve Laravel numeric-string integer cases already supported.

findings.title: JSON respons rusak menjadi ERROR evaluator
findings.problem: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR memunculkan JsonException yang tidak dikonversi menjadi assertion failure; runner menganggap summary.error sebagai ERROR.
findings.proof: invalid_json produces1JUnit error internally and3reference errors for each resource, with successful Docker readiness/cleanup.
findings.contract: A known candidate JSON contract violation must be scored as a functional failure, separate from environment errors.
findings.required_action: Convert malformed candidate JSON to explicit assertion failure and add controls confirming FAILED_INTERNAL/FAILED_REFERENCE; continue treating real environment failures as ERROR.
